question:
A retailer marks an article at $250 and offers two successive discounts of 20% and 10%.
What is the final selling price after both discounts are applied?

Two partners invest amounts in the ratio 3:2 in a business. After one year they share a profit of $25,000.
How much does the partner with the smaller investment receive?

Worker A can finish a task in 12 days and worker B in 16 days.
If they work together, approximately how many days will they take to complete the task?

A train 120 meters long passes a pole in 12 seconds.
What is the speed of the train in km/h?

A single card is drawn at random from a standard deck of 52 cards.
What is the probability that the card drawn is a heart?

From 5 distinct books, a student selects 3 to place on a shelf in a row.
In how many different ordered ways can the student arrange the chosen books?

Four friends A, B, C and D are to sit in a row. A must sit somewhere to the left of B.
How many seating arrangements satisfy this condition?

Two-fifths of a number equals 24.
What is the original number?

A town's population increases by 10% in one year and then decreases by 10% the next year.
What is the net percentage change in population after the two years?

In a simple letter-shift code each letter is replaced by the letter two positions after it in the alphabet (with wrap-around).
Using this rule, what does the word DOG become?

A shopkeeper sold an item at a loss of 4%. If the item were sold for $40 more, he would have gained 6%.
What is the cost price of the item?

A boat can travel at 12 km/h in still water. It takes 2 hours longer to go 36 km upstream than to return downstream the same distance.
What is the speed of the current?

From the letters of the word 'BALLOON', how many distinct 4-letter arrangements can be formed?
(Arrangements that differ in order are considered different.)

A commuter travels 30 km to work. He drives at 40 km/h to a point and then takes an alternate route at 60 km/h for the remaining distance so that total time equals 1 hour.
If he took the first route for x km and the alternate for (30 - x) km, what is x?

A box contains 5 red, 4 blue and 3 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random without replacement.
What is the probability that both balls are blue?

In a coding system, 'EARTH' is written as 'HCEGT'. Using the same rule, how is 'PLANT' coded?
Deduce the pattern from the example.

Five machines working together can complete a job in 8 days. After 3 days, two machines break down and remaining machines finish the remaining work in 7 more days.
How many machines were originally working?

A sequence is defined as: 3, 7, 15, 31, ...
If this pattern continues, what is the 6th term of the sequence?

A manager needs to form a 4-person committee from 6 men and 4 women such that at least 2 women are included.
How many different committees are possible?

Four couples are to be seated in a row of 8 chairs. Each couple must sit together but the order within couples can vary.
How many seating arrangements satisfy these conditions?

A complicated lock uses a 5-digit code where digits cannot repeat and the code must be an even number.
How many possible 5-digit codes satisfy these constraints?

Three runners A, B and C run a round track of 400 m. A completes a lap in 50 seconds, B in 60 seconds and C in 75 seconds.
If they start together at time 0, after how many seconds will they again be together at the starting point for the first time?
A drawer contains 10 black, 8 white and 6 red socks. If 3 socks are drawn at random without replacement, what is the probability that all three are of different colors?

A company has to schedule shifts for 7 employees so that exactly 3 work on Monday and exactly 4 work on Tuesday, with at least 2 people working both days.
If people are chosen only by names and no order matters, how many possible pairs of (Monday set, Tuesday set) exist?

A puzzle: there are 3 boxes labeled 'Apples', 'Oranges', and 'Apples and Oranges'. Each box is incorrectly labeled and contains only the fruit(s) indicated by exactly one of the other labels.
By taking a single fruit from one box, which box should you pick from to correctly relabel all three boxes, and why?

options.A: Pick from the box labeled 'Apples and Oranges' because its contents must be only apples or only oranges.
options.B: Pick from the box labeled 'Apples' because it must contain oranges.
options.C: Pick from the box labeled 'Oranges' because it must contain apples.
options.D: It is impossible to determine with a single pick.

question:
An investor wants to split $100,000 among three projects A, B and C. The expected returns (percentage) are functions of allocated amounts: A returns 5% if investment <= $50,000 else 8%; B returns flat 6%; C returns 4% plus an extra 1% if > $30,000.
To maximize immediate expected return given these stepwise conditions, which allocation strategy is best among choices?

options.A: Put $51,000 in A, $30,000 in C and the rest in B
options.B: Put $50,000 in A, $30,000 in C and the rest in B
options.C: Put $40,000 in A, $40,000 in B and $20,000 in C
options.D: Put $30,000 in A, $40,000 in B and $30,000 in C

question:
A circular table is to seat 8 people. Two particular people refuse to sit next to each other.
How many seating arrangements around the table (rotations considered identical) satisfy their condition?

A bag contains 4 fair coins and 6 biased coins; each biased coin lands heads with probability 0.75. A coin is selected at random and flipped once; it comes up heads.
What is the probability that the chosen coin was fair?

A complex logical seating: Seven colleagues P, Q, R, S, T, U, V are to be seated in a row. Q must be between P and R (not necessarily adjacent), S must be left of T, and U must be at one end.
How many seating arrangements satisfy all constraints?

A factory has machines with failure rates such that each machine independently works with probability 0.95 per day. The production line needs at least 8 out of 10 machines working to operate.
What is the probability that the line operates on a given day (rounded to four decimals) from the options below?
